key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size of the app icons in pixels.

key.name: dock-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the dock background (0 = fully transparent, 100 = solid).

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Rounding of the dock corners in pixels.

key.name: dock-padding
key.description: Inner padding around the icons in pixels.

key.name: edge-margin
key.description: Distance between the dock and the screen edge in pixels.

key.name: autohide
key.description: Hide the dock and reveal it when the pointer touches the screen edge.

key.name: position
key.description: Screen edge the dock is anchored to.

key.name: dark-background
key.description: Use a dark translucent panel instead of a light one.

key.name: show-running-indicators
key.description: Show a dot under apps that have open windows.

key.name: hover-zoom
key.description: Magnify icons on mouse hover, like macOS.
